items.docs: Creates a new team-scoped template in the **target** project (URL) from a **team-scoped** source template in the same organization. Global and feature-flag templates return 400. Cross-organization or inaccessible sources return 404. Source and destination projects must differ (400 if equal). Conflicting `template_name` values on the destination are auto-suffixed with `(copy)`, `(copy 2)`, …
